label: Thionin section and 7 T R1 map (AHEAD)
description: A coronal thionin (Nissl) section of the frontal lobe and the same brain's post-mortem 7 T R1 map at 0.6 mm (AHEAD brain 152017, Alkemade et al. 2022, CC BY 4.0).
expectedResult: The section is registered near coronal slice 50 and shown on the MRI with adjustable opacity; download the warped section, its place in the MRI grid and the Greedy transforms.
